violation_type.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
violation_type.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

finding_variants.text: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.
Teachers failed to remove water left on floor from dripping swimsuits.  A child slipped and fell on the wet floor and received an injury that required medical treatment.
An operation staff member stored a prescribed medication pill in an unsafe location where it fell out and resulted in a child in care having access to it.

At the time of the inspection the border of the school age playground had bolts standing up from the border that could catch on a shoe or clothing item causing a fall. There is a section of the playground border that has a crack that creates a concern for pinching or a child getting their finger stuck in this.

There were areas inside that pose health and safety risk to the children. Peeling paint was observed in a room where the children were napping, dust was observed on the ceilings near the vents, and there were tripping and entanglement hazards on the playground. Boards on the 2 year old playground was damaged and a nail was exposed, and there is surfacing tarp that poses a tripping hazard.
The operation has exposed sharp nails on their playground fence.
